newsitem.title: USA: Honeywell net income rises 18 percent.
newsitem.headline: Honeywell net income rises 18 percent.

text.p: Honeywell Inc. said Monday its net income climbed 18 percent in the second quarter, led by a strong performance in its commercial aviation business.

The Minneapolis-based manufacturer of control systems for use in homes, commercial buildings and industry said its earnings rose to $98.4 million, or 77 cents a share, in the quarter ended June 29, compared with $83.3 million, or 66 cents a share, in the same period last year.
The results, which were in line with Wall Street expectations, reflected gains in Honeywell's core industrial, aviation and home and building control businesses, the company said.
Total sales rose nearly 12 percent on the quarter, to $1.98 billion, while total orders for the quarter were up 9 percent.
Operating profits at its space and aviation control unit increased 38 percent for the quarter, to $61.8 million.
Honeywell's stock lost 37.5 cents to $78.8125 on the New York Stock Exchange.
